coverage.summary: Citywide Providence ordinance on rent-setting algorithms in rental housing. The only captured source, a secondary law-firm alert, states no building, unit-count, construction-date, owner-occupancy or landlord-size limits. Coverage cannot be confirmed without the ordinance text.

evidence.quoted_span: Providence Code of Ordinances ch. 13, art. X, §§ 13-69–13-73 (effective May 2025) | Prohibits the use of rent-setting algorithms; the city expressly linked the measure to software such as RealPage

result.notes: No coverage limits appear in DX06 for Providence, so all structural fields stay null. The 16-or-more-units condition in the table belongs to Portland, OR, not Providence, and was not applied. requires_unknown_facts is left null because no text describes the covered class of buildings. The ordinance appears to reach ordinary rental housing, but this cannot be verified verbatim. The only Providence-specific application in the source is the enforcement action concerning 95 Lofts. Coverage needs verification against the official text of Providence Code §§ 13-69–13-73, including definitions and any exemptions.
